أَرِيبٌ Cunning, characterized by intelligence with craft and forecast, or simply intelligent [as in the S], excellent in judgment, sagacious, (T, S, * M, K,) and knowing in affairs; (M;) as also ↓ أَرِبٌ : (K:) pl. of the former أَرَبَآءُ. (T, M.) ＝
-A2- آرَبُ A wide, an ample, or a capacious, cooking-pot. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
